# Project Phoenix v49.5 Female Rulers, Empresses, Consorts & Dowager Regents Portrait Triggers.
# Generated by gen_v495_female_toponyms_flavor.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Character scope (portrait modifiers at priority = 103, selection_behavior = max).
# Uses ONLY vanilla country tags + culture / graphical culture / rank / government / year triggers.
# Preserves east_mediterranean_gfx & roman_gfx untouched so DLC D008 Byzantine empress attire shines when installed.

# Base eligibility guard for secular adult women (rulers, consorts, dowager regents) not opted into vanilla mode.
oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = {
	exists = this
	is_adult = yes
	is_female = yes
	is_religious_figure = no
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
	NOT = { portrait_clergy_trigger = { RELIGION_GFX = buddhist_gfx } }
	NOT = { is_general = yes }
	NOT = { is_mercenary_leader = yes }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:theocracy } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { has_reform = government_reform:military_order_reform } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { country_type = army } }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode }
}

# Rank 4 imperial monarchy (sovereign empress, consort of emperor, or imperial dowager regent).
oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = {
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = {
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			OR = {
				country_rank_level = 4
				AND = {
					exists = international_organization:hre
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			is_married = yes
			num_of_spouses >= 1
			any_spouse ?= {
				is_ruler = yes
				any_ruling_countries = {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					OR = {
						country_rank_level = 4
						AND = {
							exists = international_organization:hre
							is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_regent = yes
				is_consort = yes
			}
			OR = {
				employer ?= {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					OR = {
						country_rank_level = 4
						AND = {
							exists = international_organization:hre
							is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
						}
					}
				}
				owner ?= {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					OR = {
						country_rank_level = 4
						AND = {
							exists = international_organization:hre
							is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Rank 3 royal monarchy (sovereign queen, queen consort, or royal dowager regent).
oe_v495_female_is_rank3_monarchy = {
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = {
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
			country_rank_level = 3
		}
		AND = {
			is_married = yes
			num_of_spouses >= 1
			any_spouse ?= {
				is_ruler = yes
				any_ruling_countries = {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					country_rank_level = 3
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_regent = yes
				is_consort = yes
			}
			OR = {
				employer ?= {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					country_rank_level = 3
				}
				owner ?= {
					government_type = government_type:monarchy
					country_rank_level = 3
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# East Asian dynastic courts (Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Jurchen/Manchu; excludes east_mediterranean/roman).
oe_v495_female_is_east_asian_court = {
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	OR = {
		gfx_culture_applicable = east_asian_gfx
		gfx_culture_applicable = tungusic_coa_gfx
		gfx_culture_applicable = japanese_gfx
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:tungusic_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group
			}
		}
		any_ruling_countries = {
			OR = {
				tag = MNG
				tag = CHI
				tag = CSO
				tag = CSH
				tag = KOR
				tag = JAP
			}
		}
		employer ?= {
			OR = {
				tag = MNG
				tag = CHI
				tag = CSO
				tag = CSH
				tag = KOR
				tag = JAP
			}
		}
	}
}

# 1. East Asian Empresses, Empress Dowagers & Imperial Consorts (Ming/Tang/Song/Yuan/Qing/Japan Imperial)
oe_v495_female_east_asian_empress = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	oe_v495_female_is_east_asian_court = yes
	oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes
}

# 2. East Asian Queens, Royal Dowagers & Consorts (Rank 3 Monarchy: Joseon, Kingdoms)
oe_v495_female_east_asian_queen = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	oe_v495_female_is_east_asian_court = yes
	NOT = { oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes }
	oe_v495_female_is_rank3_monarchy = yes
}

# 3. 1640+ Early-Modern European Empresses & Imperial Regents (Catherine the Great, Maria Theresa, etc.)
#    Explicitly excludes east_mediterranean_gfx & roman_gfx so DLC D008 Byzantine empress regalia shines.
oe_v495_female_euro_late_empress = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	current_year >= 1640
	gfx_culture_applicable = european_gfx
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes
}

	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }

# 5. Islamic Empresses, Valide Sultans & Regents (Kosem Sultan, Nur Jahan, etc. — Rank 4 Monarchy)
oe_v495_female_islamic_empress = {
	oe_v495_female_portrait_eligible = yes
	NOT = { oe_v495_female_is_east_asian_court = yes }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	OR = {
		gfx_culture_applicable = middle_east_gfx
		gfx_culture_applicable = levantine_gfx
		portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx }
	}
	oe_v495_female_is_rank4_monarchy = yes
}
